title: How do you install stone veneer? - GenStone
text:
How do you install stone veneer?

Stone veneer installation depends on whether you are working on an interior, exterior, or heat-adjacent surface, and what the substrate is. In general, you prep the surface, create a solid bonding or fastening base, install starter/trim details as needed, then set pieces, keep everything level, and finish edges and transitions cleanly.
